fact: Bakame AI is an AI company founded by Happy Herman Niyorurema (CEO) and Mame Diarra Niang (CSO)
Bakame Aviation is Bakame AI's flagship product — a voice AI platform for aviation training delivered via telephone
Bakame Aviation is live at aviation.bakame.online with DID number 229201520
Bakame Aviation uses PIN-based cadet authentication that is auto-generated on signup
Bakame AI's core moat is offline-capable AI delivery via telephony — no smartphone or internet required by the end user
Bakame AI runs a Qwen3-30B model with LoRA fine-tuning on a DGX Spark (NVIDIA GB10) server
Bakame AI uses in-house speech-to-text and a proprietary mixture-of-experts model; third-party model names are not disclosed in external communications
Bakame AI won the Gold M-Gov Award in Dubai
Bakame AI won the TCU 2026 Innovation Award (awarded to Happy Herman Niyorurema)
Bakame AI received $8,000 from the CREATE grant
Happy Herman Niyorurema is CEO; Mame Diarra Niang is CSO and co-founder (Senegalese)
Victor is Head of R&D; the advisory board includes the Honorable Court President and Rwanda Space Agency CEO
Bakame AI is headquartered at TCU, Fort Worth, Texas; primary deployment target is East Africa (Rwanda, Kenya, Ivory Coast)
Bakame Aviation's first live deployment is aviation training for cadets in Rwanda
Bakame AI's go-to-market for government buyers is: free pilot, paid rollout on outcomes — not upfront licensing fees
The company name is Bakame AI; the product name is Bakame Aviation — these are not interchangeable in external communications
Bakame AI competed as an Octofinalist in the Lockheed Martin AI Ethics competition
Bakame AI is fine-tuning a Kinyarwanda LoRA (r32) for local language support in Rwanda
Bakame AI focuses on voice-first AI education.
Data from Bakame Aviation is stored on servers controlled by Bakame AI.
Cadets log in using their Akagera Aviation Google account.
Bakame Aviation allows instructors to see each cadet's readbacks and weak spots.
Bakame Aviation is designed for aviation cadets working toward ICAO English Level 4.
Bakame Aviation is built on the same voice-AI stack that powers Bakame's Kinyarwanda tutor.
Cadets can track their readback accuracy and ICAO-level trend after each session.
Bakame Aviation offers 6 lessons for ICAO Level 4 practice.
Bakame Aviation includes phraseology, ATC readbacks, weather, and emergencies in its drills.
Flight schools can track cohort progression toward ICAO Level 4.
Each drill session lasts 25 minutes.
